# A61 — bottom sheet and prompt field sat under nav bar/keyboard on Android 10 gesture nav

**Section**: A. CI & build pipeline
**Keywords**: adjustresize, android, android-10, bottom, build, field, gesture, ime, imepadding, insets, keyboard, mainactivity, pipeline, prompt, root, screen, sheet, ux, windowsoftinputmode

## Problem

bottom sheet and prompt field sat under nav bar/keyboard on Android 10 gesture nav

## Root cause

no imePadding, no adjustResize

## Solution

windowSoftInputMode=adjustResize on MainActivity + imePadding on screen root
